notes.title: Online Matches and Tutorial: FIXED
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

Hope you guys are safe and healthy.

Our team has worked really hard throughout this week to solve the bugs that many people were facing with the online matches and we believe to have achieved a stable version.

The ability to add bots to the online games has been reworked and it's now functional again.

We will continue to improve on it in order to deliver a higher quality game with each new patch.

All of the major bugs reported with the tutorial should also be fixed, including the stalemate in the second part.

Please make sure to restart the Steam client and get the latest update for it to work properly.

Please keep reporting and we'll address the additional issues found.
Thank you guys a lot for your patience!

We hope to see you guys having a great time with the game.

Much love,
- The Daisu Team

notes.title: Online Multiplayer bugs
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

Today the free weekend has started and, due to the high number of concurrent players, some players are facing issues and bugs in the online matches.

The Daisu Team

notes.title: COVID-19 update from Daisu
notes.notes:
Hello all,

Harry here from the Daisu team. We hope you and your families are well and safe. These are tough and unprecedented times we're living, and it's affecting the whole community of players and the games industry. Entire cities around the world in lockdown, events being cancelled, health and economic systems in crisis, game launches being delayed. Everyone is being affected.

At Daisu, we bring the board games people love to digital platforms, allowing them to play more frequently and without boundaries, and allowing new gamers to know about these exciting titles. We care deeply about our fans and we know board game communities are being especially affected, as gatherings are not recommended or allowed. That is why, as a small token of our gratitude and to contribute the way we can to this terrible crisis, we are offering Between Two Castles Digital Edition for free during this weekend, March 26 to 30.

If you get the game during this period, you can keep it forever for free. Gather your friends but still be safe in your homes. We hope that fans of Between Two Castles and new players alike can enjoy it and use it to spend more time with their loved ones.

Thank you for the support you always show us, that humbles us quite a lot.
Be safe and use gaming to take more fun out of these troubled times.

Much love,
Harry and the Daisu team

notes.title: Online matches and Other Updates
notes.notes:
Hey folks! 

We have a great update for you today. We've heard a lot of feedback regarding the online matches need for multiple people (the game requires a minimum of 3 players). Now you can add AI players to your online matches, requiring a minimum of 2 human players instead of 3. That way you can easily grab one friend and play online with her! 

We've also corrected the rule that, in the original game, would allow you to place your tiles after your partner. That way you can now wait for your friend to place his tile and then you place yours above it, below it, etc. This can create meaningful strategies and combos and it's more in accordance with the original board game rules.

We hope that those updates will greatly enhance your experience with the game!
We honor your feedback, so let us know what you think.


Much love,
- the Daisu team
